definitions.explanation: A state of extreme emotional excitement, especially intense anger or outrage that causes loss of composure.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{激昂|げきこう}して{怒鳴|どな}った。
examples.english: He flew into a rage and shouted.

examples.japanese: {侮辱|ぶじょく}されて{激昂|げきこう}した。
examples.english: He became furious after being insulted.

examples.japanese: {激昂|げきこう}のあまり{手|て}が{出|で}てしまった。
examples.english: In my rage, I ended up hitting him.

notes:
{激昂|げきこう} describes a sudden, intense emotional outburst, usually extreme anger that causes someone to lose composure.

COMPOUND: {激|げき} (intense) + {昂|こう} (rise/swell up)

WRITING:
Also written as {激高|げきこう} with the same meaning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {激昂|げきこう}する: to fly into a rage
- {激昂|げきこう}のあまり: in one's fury (so intense that...)
- {激昂|げきこう}して{怒鳴|どな}る: to shout in a rage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {激怒|げきど}: fury, rage (strong anger, similar intensity)
- {逆上|ぎゃくじょう}: going berserk, losing all control
- {憤怒|ふんぬ}: indignation, wrath (more righteous anger)

REGISTER:
Formal/literary. In everyday speech, {怒|おこ}る or {切|き}れる is more common.
